Now live again: Official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery just dropped back to all-time low at nearly 40% off

Update: The price keeps jumping up and down from the $60 low and up to $90.

Amazon has just dropped the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery back down to its best price to date. We saw this deal come and go very quickly a couple days ago, but it is now back.

Amazon is now once again offering the Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery down at $59.99 shipped. If this offer is anything like last go around, it might not be around for very long.

You’re looking at the official iPhone Air MagSafe Battery Apple launched in September alongside its new ultra-thin iPhone. It carries a regularly list at $99 and is now very close to 40% off the sticker price. This deal is matching the offer we featured a couple days ago, but that deal quickly jumped back up in price. After spending just about all of yesterday up at $90, it has now fallen back down to the lowest price we have tracked at Amazon for the second time.

We did see a good run down at $79 via Amazon earlier in the year, alongside a couple YMMV deals and a very limited offer at the Verizon Store in and around this price, but you’re otherwise getting a chance to land this first-party charging solution at the best price yet.

There are smaller and more affordable MagSafe power banks out there, but I would argue that many of the most elegant options are close to the deal price we have here today anyway – like this Anker Nano Power Bank at $55. Some of the third-party options do, however, carry more battery capacity and there are some color options when looking outside of the Apple lineup, but I still think the official model is the most elegant option. It is one of the thinnest out there, delivers up to 65% additional charge, features iOS Battery Widget support, and fits along the back of iPhone Air perfectly.

Apple’s most accessible M5 Pro MacBook Pro sitting at all-time low pricing today ($250 off)

The authorized Apple dealers at B&H are landing this week with some particularly compelling deals on the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air at up to $220 off. And while Amazon is undercutting B&H on much of the new 2026 M5 Pro MacBook Pro models now, it still hasn’t beat out the straight $250 discount on the most affordable 14-inch M5 Pro machine you can buy.

As of right now, Amazon is charging just shy of $1,984 for the base 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and the 1TB internal SSD.

However, over at B&H this same machine in Space Black will drop down to $1,949 in the cart. Regularly $2,199, that’s a straight up $250 price drop on the most accessible M5 Pro MacBook Pro Apple makes.

For comparison sake, this model, if course, landed on Amazon back in early March at the full $2,199 list price before dipping to $2,049 for the first half of April, and ultimately down to the $1,984 we are seeing right now – it has never sold this machine for any less than that.

It is not uncommon to see some of the smaller authorized dealers offer lower prices than Amazon on the heavily upgraded MacBooks, or just offer configurations Amazon does not. But it is far less commonplace to see them serving up lower prices on the most accessible configurations in each product line like we are seeing here today. It is also worth mentioning that, if history is any indication, we do not expect to see this machine at any better than $250 off via Amazon this year, and if we do it is not likely before a major Prime or Black Friday event.

Score Mom a new current-gen iPad this year at $299 (All colors)

My Mom is totally happy with some flowers, maybe a cheap bottle of wine, and a visit, but if you’re looking to treat yours this year, or whomever you consider to be Mom, Apple’s ultra casual iPad 11 is a super sweet option. Pricey for a simple gift, sure, but not so wildly expensive either, and you can score one in any color at $299 today via Amazon.

If your Mom is a power tablet user, the base iPad 11 (A16) isn’t likely to be all that exciting. But when it comes to just having a fun and yet capable web-browsing and video chat-ready option, it is a great way to surprise Mom with an awesome Apple gift this year.

Regularly $349, Amazon has all four down at $299 shipped right now, which is on par with the best deals of the year and a great chance to land one ahead of this weekend’s big day.

Again, it’s certainly not the most powerful option, but if Mom is a just casual user, interested in a reliable tablet experience that runs Apple’s padOS for chatting with friends and family, browsing the web, making embracing posts on social media accounts, or doing some light banking, I would argue it is actually the best iPad you can get. There’s really no need to pay iPad Air prices for something this simple – the iPad 11 is roughly half the price and can likely do everything Mom needs it to.

Apple’s new mid-range 256GB 13-inch M4 iPad Air hits new all-time low today at nearly $110 off

We are starting to see deal pricing on the new M4 iPad Air lineup drop even lower this week, and fortunately not just on the most expensive models. The most affordable configuration in the lineup hit its best price yesterday and now we have the 13-inch 256GB model dropping to a new Amazon all-time low at nearly $110 off.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s new 13-inch M4 iPad Air with the 256GB storage capacity down at $789.99 shipped in all four colors.

Regularly $899, you’re looking at just shy of $110 off and the best price we have tracked on this model. Up until now, really only the most expensive 1TB variants have hit the $100 off range, but today we are getting a mid-ranger model that hits right in the sweet spot for me on the iPad Air lineup – I probably don’t need 512GB, and I certainly don’t need the 1TB (unless there is a wild deal on one), and the 128GB leaves a little too much to be desired for me.
